biotools.summary: mPROSS is a web-accessible design algorithm that uses phylogenetic analysis and atomistic potentials to improve the energy of membrane proteins, increasing their functional expression levels. It's freely available for academic use and has been demonstrated to enhance potassium-selective permeation and voltage dependence in voltage-gated potassium channels.
